title: Reverence can do what self-protection cannot.
summary: The shabad says fearlessness grows where the self is steeped in reverence, not where it keeps hardening itself.
takeaway: Become ruled by the right fear and the smaller fears begin to loosen.
lifeApplication: When you feel defensive today, choose reverence over self-armor in one small act.

source.shortMeaning: Service and reverence turn into fearlessness over time.
source.lifeApplication: Let devotion shape your emotional reflexes.

evidence.coreClaim: Service and reverence turn into fearlessness over time.
evidence.turn: Forgive deeply enough that fear loses its throne.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel defensive today, choose reverence over self-armor in one small act.
